name: 4F-MDMB-BINACA
summary: 4F-MDMB-BINACA is an indazole-based synthetic cannabinoid from the indazole-3-carboxamide family. It should not be confused with the amantadine analogue 4F-ABINACA. It has been used as an active ingredient in synthetic cannabis products and sold as a designer drug since late 2018.39 nM), though it is unclear whether it is selective for this target.

pharmacology.text: 4F-MDMB-BINACA is an agonist of the CB1 receptor (EC50 = 7.39 nM), though it is unclear whether it is selective for this target.

uses.text: It has been used as an active ingredient in synthetic cannabis products and sold as a designer drug since late 2018.

sideEffects.en: It is a highly potent synthetic cannabinoid. Reported effects include a racing heart, vomiting, agitation, anxiety, paranoia, confusion and loss of consciousness. Seizures, psychosis and deaths have been linked to it, and regular use can lead to dependence and harsh withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 它是效力極強的合成大麻素。已知的反應包括心跳急促、嘔吐、躁動、焦慮、多疑、意識混亂與失去意識。它曾與癲癇發作、精神病及死亡有關，長期使用也可能導致成癮與嚴重的戒斷反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它是效力极强的合成大麻素。已知的反应包括心跳急促、呕吐、躁动、焦虑、多疑、意识混乱与失去意识。它曾与癫痫发作、精神病及死亡有关，长期使用也可能导致成瘾与严重的戒断反应。

fact.en: Its name is chemical shorthand: 4F for a fluorine at the end of its four-carbon tail, MDMB for its methyl dimethylbutanoate group, and BINACA for its butyl indazole carboxamide core.
fact.zh: 它的名稱是化學縮寫：「4F」表示四碳尾端有一個氟，「MDMB」代表二甲基丁酸甲酯基團，「BINACA」則代表丁基吲唑甲醯胺核心。
fact.zhHans: 它的名称是化学缩写：「4F」表示四碳尾端有一个氟，「MDMB」代表二甲基丁酸甲酯基团，「BINACA」则代表丁基吲唑甲酰胺内核。
